data.title: AMCR Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates, Sales Beat on Berry Acquisition
data.body: Amcor's Q3 sales surge 77% y/y on the Berry deal, beating estimates as margins improve, but softer demand and lower FY26 outlook temper the momentum.

data.title: AptarGroup Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates but Decline Y/Y, Shares Dip 1%
data.body: ATR tops Q1 earnings estimates on strong sales growth, but profit declines, pharma headwinds and margin pressure send shares down despite an upbeat Q2 outlook.

data.title: Amcor Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
data.body: AMCR heads into Q3 earnings release with strong y/y revenue growth forecasts, but weak demand, cost pressures and a negative ESP cloud the outlook.
